name: continuous-monitor
description: Unattended, scheduled monitoring of external sources (arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, PubMed, bioRxiv/medRxiv, GDELT, Hacker News) for a topic: scores candidates via Interest-Inference against the concordance, ranks them through the Recommendation Engine, and gates every candidate through a mandatory human Editorial Gate (a review pull request) before anything is projected into a real MIF finding.
